statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-0545 is an authentication bypass on FastAPI job endpoints in mlflow when basic-auth and job execution are both enabled. No upstream fix is available yet (affected: <=3.10.1). The vulnerability requires MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_JOB_EXECUTION=true and an allowlisted job function, neither of which is configured by default. Monitoring upstream for a patched release.
